recorded.values: INVENTED. Every situation below is synthetic, written in the same shapes as the main set (ranking-scenarios.json) and derived from the same sources — S4 §6.1, §6.4, §6.5, §13, invariants 2 and 3, and AC-9 §14.4 — with different situations and wording. No production lead, message, contact or property is reproduced.
recorded.purpose: HOLDOUT for SA-12.6. The main set's third measurement (2026-09-14) held 8 of 10 runs, and its prompt wording had been shaped by that same set, so the Accountable decided on 2026-09-15 (option A) that a further repair be measured on a NEW set frozen before the implementation changes. This set is that set: authored and frozen by the coding agent on 2026-09-15, BEFORE any change to the ranking implementation after the third measurement, and without running the judge on it.
recorded.independence: It is NOT used for tuning. It is measured once per implementation, in two batches of five, alongside the main set. An implementation changed after observing its results is not measured against it again as independent evidence; a further repair would need another set frozen before that change.
recorded.barsEstablishedBy: The bars below are the ones ratified by Alejandro Torres Padilla, the Accountable, on 2026-09-14 (Slice Plan v1.30), before implementation, for SL-12's RS-2 only — copied unchanged. SA-12.6's semantics and scope are unchanged; only the scenarios are new.
recorded.size: Nine scenarios, the main set's size, so one failure weighs the same against the 20% bar in both sets.
recorded.scoring: Identical to the main set (run-ranking-eval.ts scoreRankingScenario): UNSUPPORTED ATTENTION (bar 0) when a case in `must_not_admit` is admitted; FLOOR VIOLATION (bar 0) when a governed case is missing from the final order; ORDINARY FAILURE (counted in the failure rate) for no judgment, a case in `expect_contextual` not admitted, or an `order_pairs` pair out of order.
